label: Auction refinements. Players pool: sort by name / prior-season points / ADP, filter by position and NFL team, and the list now shows even when the auction is closed (Nominate appears only once it's live). Tap any player name for the full player modal. Bid History is now collapsible per-player threads with date + time stamps. Cadence and Schedule merged into one Tracker tab. Both auctions share the same tabs and nominate wiring.
